questions.english: The form asks for "Awareness and understanding of how Equality, Diversity and Inclusion, Dignity & Respect, and Human Rights will apply to this role.": what would you write?
questions.why: The app asks this itself: the form wants it in your own words, and none of your confirmed facts says it in the first person.

answer.text: I have worked for three years in a care home in Leeds; I started in October 2023.
For me dignity means knocking before entering, explaining what I will do before personal care, and always closing curtains.
I respect each person's culture and religion by asking what they want to eat, how they want to be treated, and whether they prefer being helped by a woman.
One night I saw a bruise on a resident's arm, and I recorded it and told the nurse on duty immediately.
In the dementia unit the residents were agitated at the end of the day, so we as a team moved dinner earlier.
I have moving and handling training and I use the hoist when supporting residents to move.
I have medication training and I do the morning medication round for 18 residents.
Before each shift I read each resident's care plan and do what is there.
At the end of the shift I write daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet.
We always work in pairs.
I made cards with food photos so each person can point to what they want to eat.
I did three years of nights, and also weekends.

letter.text: Dear North Yorkshire Council hiring team,
I am applying for the Care and Support Worker role at North Yorkshire Council.
I have worked for three years in a care home in Leeds; I started in October 2023.
I have medication training and I do the morning medication round for 18 residents.
I have moving and handling training and I use the hoist.
Thank you for considering my application.
